title: PvE Matchmaking Toggle Test: Thanks for taking part!
body:
# PvE Matchmaking Toggle Test: Thanks for taking part!

The limited-time PvE matchmaking toggle test is now over. Thank you to everyone who joined in and gave us valuable data and insights.

Players completed more than 30 million rounds of PvE during the test period. That leaves us with a massive amount of information to work through, so we'll need some time to study the numbers and pull out meaningful insights.

We also want to hear your personal thoughts and reflections on the test. How did the PvE experience compare to your usual sessions? What should be improved? How did the typical PvPvE experience shift during the test? Share your thoughts in the PvE-test-feedback channel on Discord. We'll also be sending a survey to a representative sample of ARC Raiders players starting October 22.

# What next?

As noted above, we need some time to make sense of both the data and the community feedback. From an initial look, it's clear the test has split opinion. As always, we'll base our next steps on what keeps the game healthy and enjoyable overall.

We don't yet know what the data analysis will reveal, but we expect to share more information in November.

Thank you again for taking part in the test and for sharing your feedback. It plays a key role in helping us make informed decisions about the game's development.

Speak soon, Raiders.

The ARC Raiders Team
